rtx5060ti.alt: A GeForce RTX 5060 Ti with 16 GB, made by PNY: two fans, a metal bracket with the video ports, and the gold edge connector that goes into the motherboard.
rtx5060ti.caption: A home card: the GeForce RTX 5060 Ti with 16 GB. NVIDIA makes the chip, and board makers such as PNY build the card around it.
rtx5060ti.author: FreeMediaKid!

rtx3090v4090.alt: Two large graphics cards with three fans each, an RTX 3090 above and a wider RTX 4090 below.
rtx3090v4090.caption: An RTX 3090 (top, Ampere) and an RTX 4090 (bottom, Ada Lovelace). Both have 24 GB. The top tier grew with each generation.
rtx3090v4090.author: Benlisquare

pcb5090.alt: The bare circuit boards of the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 Founders Edition cards. Each has a large square chip in the middle with small black memory chips around it.
pcb5090.caption: The boards of the RTX 5080 and RTX 5090 without their coolers. The large square is the GPU chip. The small black rectangles around it are the GDDR7 memory chips: that is the VRAM.
pcb5090.author: Geekerwan

ada6000.alt: Four slim RTX 6000 Ada workstation cards side by side in one open computer.
ada6000.caption: Four RTX 6000 Ada workstation cards in one machine. Each has 48 GB and a slim shape with one fan at the end, so they fit side by side.
ada6000.author: Geekerwan

spark.alt: A small gold-coloured metal box on a wooden desk: the NVIDIA DGX Spark.
spark.caption: The DGX Spark: a whole AI computer in a box that fits in one hand.
spark.author: Daniel Lu (dllu)

h100.alt: Four gold-coloured H100 cards standing in a row. They have no fans.
h100.caption: H100 cards. They have no fans: the server pushes air through them.
h100.author: Geekerwan

dgxb200.alt: A large server board with eight tall black GPU modules, labelled HGX B200.
dgxb200.caption: Eight B200 GPUs on one board, the inside of a B200 server.
dgxb200.author: Pokiiri

gb200.alt: A tall black server rack filled with flat trays: an NVIDIA GB200 rack.
gb200.caption: A GB200 rack with 72 Blackwell GPUs and 36 Grace processors, cooled by liquid. It is sold as one machine.
gb200.author: Pokiiri

jetson.alt: A small grey box with cooling fins next to its retail carton: the Jetson AGX Orin developer kit.
jetson.caption: The Jetson AGX Orin developer kit, a complete computer for a robot.
jetson.author: Auledas
